metaDescription: Estimate a price for a sponsored post from followers and engagement with a rate per 1,000 followers that you set. Free, private.
intro: Estimate a fair price for a sponsored post from followers and engagement, using a rate per 1,000 followers that you set yourself.
why:
Creators and brands often ask what a post is worth. No single market rate exists, and public rate tables vary by platform, niche and year.

This tool is a calculator for your own rate card. Set a base rate per 1,000 followers, compare your engagement rate with an average you choose, add a format multiplier and a usage-rights add-on, and see an estimate with a rough negotiation band. The defaults are placeholders, not data.
howTo: Set your base rate per 1,000 followers and the average engagement rate.
Add a format multiplier and usage rights if needed.
Use the estimate as a starting point for a quote.

faq.q: Where do the default numbers come from?
faq.a: They are placeholders. Replace them with rates you have been paid or quoted.
Your rate divided by the average, kept between 0.5 and 2 times.
No. It is plus or minus 25 percent as a negotiation range.

keywords: how much to charge for sponsored post
